lessons.title: KVPool/MLA contract family: the tail is test-side — grep old kwargs to ZERO in tests/ut (init_kv_cache attn_groups is new)
lessons.symptom: run 34078835752 step-1 (vllm 8bdc70ec) pre_ci exhausted after UT failures converged 34→30→5. ALL 5 remaining failures are TEST-side constructions still using the OLD contract: TypeError: KVCacheTensor.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'shared_by' (tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v1.py TestNPUModelRunnerKVCache x5, tests/ut/worker/test_attn_utils_v2.py dsv4_cache_only_layer x2), MLAAttentionSpec(...compress_ratio=...) (tests/ut/test_compressed_prefix_cache.py, tests/ut/patch/platform/test_prefix_cache_cp_patches.py x3). Runtime-side mapping was already applied.
lessons.root_cause: The old→new mapping was applied to vllm_ascend but the family grep was not driven to zero in tests/ut. extends L20260906-001 with one NEW symbol: init_kv_cache() gained an attn_groups keyword argument. Same family killed runs 33944487577 step-7, 33976675052 step-1, 34046694076 step-1.
fix_guidance: Mapping table (release→upstream main): KVCacheTensor.shared_by→layers; MLAAttentionSpec.compress_ratio→tokens_per_state/num_states; spec.indexes_kv_by_block_stride→removed (derived from KVCacheLayout); NEW: init_kv_cache() now takes attn_groups=<...> — read the upstream def for the value each call site must pass

grep EVERY old kwarg ('shared_by', 'compress_ratio', 'indexes_kv_by_block_stride') in BOTH vllm_ascend/ AND tests/ut/ until zero hits — the usual last failures are test-side constructions in tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v1.py, test_attn_utils_v2.py, test_compressed_prefix_cache.py, tests/ut/patch/platform/test_prefix_cache_cp_patches.py
A shrinking trajectory (41→9, 34→30→5) means the mapping is RIGHT — do not re-analyze the upstream commit; finish the zero-reference grep instead
